info.name: NCBI Entrez E-utilities History Info API

params.name: db
params.description: Target database. Omit to return a list of all valid Entrez databases.

params.name: version
params.description: Set to '2.0' for EInfo XML version 2.0 with additional field attributes.

params.name: tool
params.description: Name of application making the call.

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key to enable higher request rate.

items.docs: Provides a list of all valid Entrez databases, or information about a single database including field names, index terms, links to other Entrez databases, and other metadata.
